name: print-social-hand-drawn-marketing-studio-square-flyer-full-view
title: Hand-Drawn Marketing Studio Square Flyer
whatItIs: A full view of a square flyer with a black ruled frame, five tilted lilac and mint MarketingStrategy pills across the top, a heavy 'Marketing Studio.' headline, a bold-plus-light subhead, small copy and social icons, a smiling line-art lightbulb and a ticker strip at the base on a lilac wash.
whatItMeans: Simple black outlines, pastel pills and a doodle keep a business flyer friendly and modern.
techniques: Ruled frame dividing the layout into zones
Tilted pastel pills as sticker decoration
Heavy headline with a bold-and-light subhead pair
Doodle bulb with a face as a mascot

vocabulary.definition: Thin black lines that divide a layout into zones.
Two weights of the same family within one line.
A simple drawing used as a friendly character.
